text: Yushi Wei and colleagues' RayFlex study on visual pseudo-haptics for weight perception in distant VR interaction is published in IEEE TVCG.
Yushi Wei and colleagues' study of gaze-cursor visibility, confirmation methods and task demands in VR is published in IEEE TVCG.
Fangtao Zhao and colleagues' Row Across Time, a tangible Ba He Tong VR rowing game, has been accepted to CHI PLAY Companion 2026.
Jiaying Fu and colleagues' study of stakeholder influence in heritage VR game co-design has been accepted to PACM HCI (GAMES) for CHI PLAY 2026.
Mengqi Jiang and colleagues' research on a design space for smart textiles in XR has been published online in Virtual Reality.
